competences.description: Attacks all enemies to disturb HP recovery for 2 turns.

Removes all harmful effects on the boss to grant Recovery by the number of harmful effects removed for 2 turns and attacks the enemy 3 times. Gains 1 stack of Chaos Force whenever attacking an enemy granted with Unrecoverable.
Attacks all enemies. Gains 5 stacks of Chaos Force if the boss's HP is at 50% or above. When attacking enemies granted with Unrecoverable, Chaos Force increases by the number of those enemies.

Decreases the HP of all enemies by 1% per stack of Chaos Force, and then attacks all enemies. The damage dealt increases by 1% per stack of Chaos Force. This attack does not activate passive skills of the enemies.
